approvalScope.description: Approval with conditions for WEOS-OD-018 Stage 1 repository-native Governance Decision Envelope contracts, schemas, extension-registry contracts, pure validation, standing and supersession resolution utilities, conformance tests and documentation integration.

approverAuthority: Founding Architecture Authority bootstrap authority for initial WEOS governance foundation only
rationale: WEOS requires a common immutable Governance Decision Envelope with versioned domain-specific extension contracts before agents or future runtime work can compare authority-bearing decisions across artifacts. This record approves WEOS-OD-018 with conditions for Stage 1 repository-native contracts only.
conditions: exact and multi-target references are required through primaryTarget and targetReferences
exact revision requirements are controlled by the registered extension policy
authority evidence is preserved at decision time and later expiry or revocation must not rewrite history
finalized decisions are append-only; correction, withdrawal or replacement requires a new decision ID
supersession is scoped and must not silently become global
outcome and effective-action semantics are controlled by the registered extension policy
envelopeSchemaVersion and extensionSchemaVersion are independently versioned
WEOS-OD-021 records remain canonical for document authority and are not replaced or converted
non-human authority requires an explicit approved extension policy
legacy history is never invented from workflow, validation, audit or projection records
no Prisma, persistence, API, runtime service, command handler, projection synchronization, deployment or enforcement work is authorized

bootstrapAuthority.scope: Initial WEOS governance foundation for repository-native Governance Decision Envelope contracts, JSON schemas, TypeScript contracts, pure in-memory extension registry, validation, immutability checks, standing and supersession resolution, conformance tests and documentation integration only. This does not grant editorial, publication, clinical, institutional, operational, Prisma, database, API, runtime enforcement or production rollout authority.
bootstrapAuthority.expiryCondition: Expires when a permanent authority-assignment process approved under WEOS-OD-022 becomes effective.
